verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. The doodle frame is left empty and 'WE LOVE YOU!' is pulled out of it and shrunk, so the headline is lost. The text is crammed into a tight stack with no spacing, and the reading order is jumbled: 'DEAR TEACHERS!' sits below the school name and the headline comes before the event title. A is slightly better because its block sits nearer the middle (about 97px above, 105px below), while B is pushed up and leaves a bigger empty area at the bottom.
